mapper.update: UPDATE prompt_versions SET prompt_content = #{promptContent}, description = #{description}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE prompt_versions SET status = #{status}, is_default = #{isDefault}, activated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT prompt_content FROM prompt_versions WHERE prompt_type = #{promptType} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM prompt_ab_tests WHERE prompt_type = #{promptType} AND status = 'RUNNING' LIMIT 1
SELECT id FROM prompt_versions WHERE prompt_type = #{promptType} AND is_default = 1 LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM prompt_performance_metrics WHERE version_id = #{versionId} ORDER BY recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1
